items.headline: Nix won't be shy to scramble after ankle surgery

items.headline: Bills' Gardner-Johnson carted off with leg injury

items.headline: Tracy expects Contreras back for Red Sox Sunday

items.headline: Pirates acquire Yankees' Doval to bolster bullpen

items.headline: Source: WNBA won't discipline Bueckers, Reese
